name: Regal
tagline: Voice AI agent platform for contact centers.
description: A platform to build, deploy, and manage AI voice agents that handle inbound and outbound customer interactions across phone, SMS, chat, and WebRTC. Agents learn from past conversations, and a 2026 Copilot lets teams stand up a working voice agent within a day using existing business processes.
insight: Founded 2020 by Alex Levin and Rebecca Greene; backed by ~$83M, its agents handled roughly 350M calls in 2025.

modelSupport.notes: Vendor-managed voice agent stack; model orchestration handled by Regal.

edge: Tuned for high-volume contact-center calling — its agents draw on millions of prior calls, and Copilot ships a working voice agent in about a day.
pros: Phone, SMS, chat, and WebRTC in one platform
Agents improve from past call data
Copilot shortens build time to ~a day
cons: Enterprise focus; heavier setup than DIY APIs

references.title: Regal AI launches Copilot for building self-improving voice AI agents
